mission: Test whether the exactness and measured quotient-search behavior of R12B generalize to previously unexposed GENERAL_CNF frame/interface worlds while keeping the compiler logic frozen byte-for-byte at the R12B execution lineage.

compiler_freeze.rule: NO LOGIC CHANGE, NO WIDTH CHANGE, NO THRESHOLD TUNING, NO NEW PRUNING RULE, NO WITNESS-DEPENDENT ROUTING AFTER THE R13 WORLD SET IS REVEALED. Harness-only changes required to present unseen inputs or collect frozen metrics must be isolated and must not alter compiler semantics.

unseen_rule.definition: An R13 inferential world/interface must not have been used to design, tune, inspect, validate, or debug the R12B compiler logic before this preregistration.
unseen_rule.provenance_requirement: Each world must carry a creation/source commit, frame hash, interface-variable set, and an explicit statement of whether any exact witness or prime-implicate set was accessible before candidate fixed point.
unseen_rule.leakage_firewall: Exact witness/interface truth may be consulted only after candidate fixed point for scoring, exactly as in the R12B scientific firewall.

allowed: canonical forbidden partial assignments / non-tautological clauses of width <=4
exact subsumption / semantic dominance already present in R12B
fixed-width resolution already present in R12B
memoization/canonical-state lookup already present in R12B
forbidden: exact witness access before fixed point
problem-specific heuristics introduced after seeing R13 failures

primary_endpoints.E1_exact_allowed_set: candidate_allowed == exact_allowed with FP=0 and FN=0
primary_endpoints.E2_exact_prime_interface: candidate minimal bridge basis contains exactly the required prime interface under the frozen scoring contract, or the preregistered equivalent exactness witness if prime enumeration is unavailable for a particular world
primary_endpoints.E3_width_integrity: no candidate state of width >4 is created or borrowed
primary_endpoints.E4_scientific_firewall: exact witness remains inaccessible until candidate fixed point

scaling_endpoints.critical_question: Does measured transition work and active-basis maintenance remain within a defensible polynomial envelope as n,m,b grow, rather than merely living inside a polynomial-sized universe?

verdict_ladder.PASS_EXACT_SCOPED: All frozen exactness and integrity endpoints pass on the unseen test set, but sample size/scaling range is insufficient for a polynomial claim.
verdict_ladder.OPEN_WIDTH_WITNESS: At least one unseen world is not exactly recovered at k=4 and evidence indicates a required interface/derivation outside the frozen width contract; preserve the counterexample and do not tune R12B in place.
verdict_ladder.OPEN_TRANSITION_COMPLEXITY: Exactness continues to pass but measured transition/runtime growth is incompatible with or insufficient to support the preregistered polynomial envelope.
verdict_ladder.FAIL_UNSOUND: FP/FN or proof replay demonstrates that quotient pruning merged states that differ on the target decision invariant.
verdict_ladder.BLOCKED_RESOURCE_LIMIT: Execution ends before the scientific gate; silence is not negative evidence and must be recorded as UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_LIMIT/BLOCKED_RESOURCE_LIMIT rather than failure.
verdict_ladder.STRONGER_CANDIDATE: Only if unseen exactness persists and a separately specified scaling analysis supports a polynomial transition/runtime envelope over a meaningful range; this status still does not equal P=NP.

multiplicity_and_scaling_rule.polynomial_fit_policy: Do not call behavior polynomial merely because a low-degree polynomial fits a small range. Compare candidate envelopes against alternative growth models, report residuals/ratios, and preserve insufficient-range verdicts.
multiplicity_and_scaling_rule.counterexample_priority: One valid unseen counterexample to fixed-k completeness overrides aggregate compression success.

representation_contract.target_invariant_I: exact satisfiable bridge/interface behavior and witness-preserving forbidden structure
representation_contract.representation_R: R12B canonical minimal forbidden-pattern quotient at width<=4
must_preserve: all distinctions capable of changing exact allowed bridge assignments
all prime/interface constraints required for exact scoring
may_discard: subsumed weaker forbidden patterns that cannot restore an allowed witness
representation_contract.falsifier: Any FP/FN, failed proof replay, or unseen world whose required distinction was erased by quotienting.
representation_contract.control_power: The unseen worlds are explicitly allowed to break R12B; failure is evidence, not a prompt for in-run retuning.

canonical_seal: FREEZE THE R12B COMPILER. SHOW IT WORLDS IT HAS NEVER SEEN. SCORE EXACTNESS FIRST, SCALING SECOND, AND LET A SINGLE REAL COUNTEREXAMPLE SAY NO. DO NOT MOVE THE GOALPOSTS AFTER THE WORLD ANSWERS.
